issues.description: Duplicate "transcriber_error" entry in error message_type tuple
issues.detail: The tuple in the elif branch lists "transcriber_error" twice. Harmless at runtime but signals copy-paste error and may indicate another intended type was missed (e.g., one of these slots was meant for a different error). Should be deduplicated and cross-checked against the ElevenLabs docs list.

issues.description: push_error is called with a raw string but likely expects an ErrorFrame
issues.detail: Other Pipecat services typically wrap errors as ErrorFrame objects before pushing. Passing `error_msg=f"Error: {error_msg}"` as a kwarg presumes a specific signature. If push_error expects a Frame, downstream handlers will misbehave. Worth verifying the signature matches the base class contract.

issues.description: Loss of error-level logging for auth and quota errors
issues.detail: Previously auth_error and quota_exceeded_error were logged at logger.error with distinct prefixes. After collapsing, only push_error is called with no logger.error/warning. Operators lose visibility in logs unless push_error logs internally. Consider retaining a logger.error call before pushing.

issues.description: Removed broad exception handler may surface noisy tracebacks
issues.detail: The previous wrapper caught Exception in _receive_messages and logged a friendly "WebSocket connection closed" warning. Removing it fixes the infinite loop but normal disconnects (ConnectionClosed) will now propagate as unhandled exceptions up to the reconnect loop, potentially producing noisier logs. Consider catching ConnectionClosed specifically and logging a clean message.
`changelog/3233.fixed.md` ends without a trailing newline ("\ No newline at end of file"). Minor POSIX hygiene issue; some linters and concatenation tools dislike this. Add a final newline.

issues.description: Error fallback message format is inconsistent for known types
issues.detail: When `data.get("error")` is absent, the fallback is `f"Unknown error - {message_type}"`. For specific types like auth_error or quota_exceeded_error this is less descriptive than the prior "Authentication error"/"Quota exceeded" defaults. Consider a small mapping for human-readable fallbacks per type.

review.summary: The PR correctly identifies and fixes a real infinite-loop bug by removing the inner try/except in _receive_messages so disconnect exceptions can propagate to the outer reconnect loop. Error handling is broadened across documented ElevenLabs error types, which is a clear win. Main concerns: a duplicated "transcriber_error" entry suggests a copy-paste oversight, the consolidation drops logger.error calls for auth/quota errors, and the new code no longer distinguishes clean ConnectionClosed disconnects from unexpected errors which may produce noisier logs.
